verses.1: Yehova, my God, you are the one who has made me remember your name. For you have done wonders from afar, truly and indeed.
verses.2: For you have abandoned the city of Lagal Kriya in a state of ruin. Foreigners will never be able to build it again.
verses.3: Therefore, they will be destroyed by you. A people full of arrogance and hatred will fear you.
verses.4: For you were too weak to protect your father in his times of hardship. He was protected from the dangers that surrounded him, as if by a shadow from above. For the evil spirits were like a wall that protected him.
verses.5: In the time of chaos, foreign invaders will be defeated. They will be defeated by those who are strong and brave.
verses.6: And Jehovah created His armies for all the nations on this mountain. They were made of wheat, barley, lentils, peas, and rye.
verses.7: And in this mountain lies the face of the Lotus. The Lotus covers all nations and all peoples.
verses.8: May death be forever banished from us! May the throne of Jehovah be cleansed from all stains and defilements. May the disgrace of His people be removed from all over the earth, because Jehovah has spoken.
verses.9: And on that day, our God will come to us, and He will save us. Jehovah will come to us. We will be joyful in His salvation.
verses.10: For the hand of the LORD shall rest upon this mountain, and He shall be exalted beneath it, just as a potter works clay into the shape of a vessel.
verses.11: And he stretched out his hands towards his chest, as the blade of the knife was being cut away from its handle. He also bent his knees together with his arms.
verses.12: And from the depths of our decay, our bodies were destroyed. They reached the land of Afer.
